All my 6 dogs love it

I was referred desert Hills by family.   While they didn’t seem to be taking new patients,  the Vet was willing to take my dog Magic.   I can’t say enough about how the staff treated My Dog Magic and I.  He had been acting lethargic and wasn’t himself for a few days.    While not getting the greatest news, the Dr. did provide an array of options and truly cared about Magics well-being.  He even wanted me to phone him after the weekend to touch base about Magic”s condition.  Magic has improved and has been doing significantly well since.   The Doctors courtesy and approach were top notch.  He gave me options and didn’t suggest any specific treatment.  He let me decide based on possible and probable outcomes.  I would recommend this Vet as a whole to anyone who loves their pets.
